target_users: macOS power users and developers who want a Stream Deck-like dock for launching commands and chatting with LLMs
key_features: Glassmorphic floating dock panel with drag support
Multi-screen button grid (5x3) with configurable buttons
Button editor with label, icon, command type, and color customization
Shell command, AppleScript, terminal, and URL launch types
LLM chat panel with Anthropic/OpenAI/OpenCode provider support
Settings panel for LLM provider/model/API key configuration
risks: No git repository — no version control, no history, no collaboration path
No test suite — zero automated verification of any component
API keys stored unencrypted in localStorage (src/store/useStore.ts persists full llmConfig)
Direct browser-to-API calls with CORS bypass headers (anthropic-dangerous-direct-browser-access) — only safe for local use
No linter configured — code quality enforcement is manual
